name: Default Privacy Policy
description: Standard privacy hygiene policy for transaction planning. This policy enforces basic operational discipline to reduce transaction linkability.

rules.name: No Address Reuse
rules.description: Prevent reusing addresses within a transaction plan
rules.rationale: Address reuse creates clear links between transactions. Once an address is used, it becomes associated with your identity or activity patterns.

rules.name: Minimum Delay
rules.description: Ensure minimum time between transaction steps
rules.rationale: Transactions occurring in quick succession are easily correlated by timing analysis. A minimum delay reduces this risk.

rules.name: Maximum Delay
rules.description: Limit maximum delay to reasonable bounds
rules.rationale: Very long delays may be impractical and increase exposure to price volatility or failed transactions.

rules.name: No Same Block
rules.description: Prevent multiple transactions in the same block
rules.rationale: Transactions in the same block are trivially linkable. Any observer can see they were submitted together.

rules.name: Minimum Hops
rules.description: Require minimum number of intermediate steps
rules.rationale: Multiple hops through transit wallets provide separation between source and destination.

rules.name: Maximum Hops
rules.description: Limit maximum hops to prevent excessive complexity
rules.rationale: Too many hops increases gas costs and execution risk without proportional privacy benefit.
